data.summary: Confirmed Runbook 21 contract: run-owner Human-in-the-loop approval of one immutable MM.PR.CreateDraft subject, full drift revalidation, durable exactly-once continuation, existing Gateway authority, fake/sandbox verification only, and no new live SAP WRITE.

Implemented the Runbook 21 single-owner HITL Action governance runtime: complete immutable PlanApprovalRecord binding and display evidence, durable pending/decision/revocation lifecycle, authoritative reload and fail-closed revalidation, per-continuation lease and durable result recovery, production approval-route and server Gateway wiring, governed replay events with terminal SSE states, and plan-aware Java/Python/schema guard compatibility. Build review covered all 35 acceptance items; validation used fake/sandbox boundaries only and performed no live SAP WRITE.

All 35 acceptance items passed with fresh frontend, Gateway, Agent, PR Eval, call-plan, OpenSpec, and no-live-WRITE evidence; the single-user HITL approval path is fail-closed and exactly-once at the fake/sandbox boundary.
